title: FreshCut brief — what the machine gets (concept §6, Ledger 2026-09-24)
description: One row in `intake` per completed flow. Claude Code never interprets taste — it stores it. The merge is deterministic from (taps, lexicon_version).

name.description: S0 — the one typed field (name or show name).

wildcard.description: S1 '?' chosen — read taste as the primary signal; kit may be more adventurous by rule.

picks.description: S2 — three archetype ids, no labels were shown.

world.description: S4 fragment id, or 'logo' when the extracted tenth swatch was chosen.

accent.description: Optional second world used as accent.

logo_palette.description: Extracted from the uploaded logo, stored DESCRIPTIVELY (nearest world + dominant/accent words). Hex values may be kept for the operator but are never shown to the client.

cta.description: Two picks = two endcards in rotation.

references.description: S9 — 1–3 clips/photos of the person + logo. Optional; the name card preview switches to their frame when a clip lands.

skipped.description: Screens skipped (once per screen max). Each took the lexicon default.

merged_fragments.description: The five merged slots — the page the prompts are written from.

operator_call_first.description: True when skipped.length >= 4 (concept §3) — a client who is not sure what they want gets a call before the kit is built.

name_card_path.description: Rendered PNG of the final name card (the client's first asset; becomes their dashboard header).
